text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq draws up ambitious plans to develop oil and gas production.
- Russia will develop, apart from Qurna, two more oilfields in the south.
- U.N. Security Council avoids discussing the flight by an Iraqi plane to Saudi Arabia last week.
- Arab personalities and newspapers hail Iraq's decision to send a plane to Saudi Arabia.
- North Korea accuses the United States of attempts to contain it militarily.
- Health minister receives chairman of a Chinese pharmaceutical firm.
- Vice-chairman of the Revolutionary Command Council calls for the monitoring of the harvest campaign.
(The above were also carried by THAWRA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Article on President Saddam Hussein's thoughts on the Third World.
- Two articles on the recapture by the Iraqi army of Fao peninsula from the Iranians during the 1980-1988 Iraq-Iran war.
- Defence ministry bans wearing of uniform by non-military personnel.
- National Assembly speaker receives Palestinian ambassador in Iraq.
- Article on Iran's aggressive intentions in the Gulf.
